description: This file defines the Currency entity class for the sales management system, mapping to the CURRENCY database table. It includes fields such as id, currency code, name, supported status, and methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Entity class representing a currency, with properties like id, currency code, name, and supported status, mapped to the corresponding database table.

methods.name: Currency
methods.description: Default constructor for the Currency entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the currency.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the currency.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the java.util.Currency object associated with this currency entity.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the java.util.Currency object and updates the currency code.

methods.name: getSupported
methods.description: Returns whether this currency is supported.

methods.name: setSupported
methods.description: Sets the supported status of the currency.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code, ensuring synchronization with the currency object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currency.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the currency.
